extensionName.message: Auto Tab Timer – Tab Countdown Timer & Auto Close Tabs

extensionDescription.message: Automatically close any tab after a set time using a simple tab countdown timer.

onboardingUpdateSubtitle.message: Version 1.3.0 includes timer input guardrails, clearer completion-action behavior, and new onboarding/update pages.

whatsNew130Item1.message: Timer input guardrails now clamp hours to 0..999 and minutes/seconds to 0..59.

whatsNew130Item2.message: Starting a timer with 00:00:00 now shows a localized inline validation error.

whatsNew130Item3.message: "Notify me only" behavior is clarified, and onboarding now includes developer extension recommendations.

whatsNew130Item4.message: New install onboarding and one-time 1.3.0 update page are now live.

whatsNew130Item5.message: No new permissions are required, and existing workflows continue as before.
